## View Paper

**[Osteoarthritis detection by applying quadtree analysis to human joint knee X-ray imagery](https://www.tandfonline.com/doi/abs/10.1080/1206212X.2020.1838145?journalCode=tjca20)**

## Publication

**Authors:** Sophal Chan, Kwankamon Dittakan, Subhieh El Salhi  
**Venue:** *International Journal of Computers and Applications*, Vol. 44, No. 6, 2020  
**DOI:** [10.1080/1206212X.2020.1838145](https://doi.org/10.1080/1206212X.2020.1838145)

## Background of the Study

Shape analysis complements texture methods for radiographic OA screening in aging populations.

## Motivation of the Study

Apply **quadtree decomposition** to identify ROIs and thresholds that maximize separation of normal vs. OA knees.

## Key Result

Dataset 3 (Otsu knee joint space ROI), threshold **10** → **AUC = 0.917** (128 participants, 66 OA images).
